crossRefs.note: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of…
Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

translations.web: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
translations.bsb: He made the veil of blue, purple, and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim woven into it.
translations.kjv: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
translations.asv: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubim thereon.
